missions.title: Lamp Starter
missions.description: "The train stops outside an unfamiliar base, and a new storm is brewing."

missions.title: Propagation I
missions.description: "I know this is a gamble, but it's the only option we have."

missions.title: Refraction Point
missions.description: "The AR Team sets out in order to take the coastal defense artillery."

missions.title: Critical Angle I
missions.description: "Squad 404 sets out in order to open the gate blocking the Commander's path."

missions.title: Reflector I
missions.description: "The various Griffin squads fight a blocking action to stop the Military."

missions.title: Critical Angle III
missions.description: "The path to the objective is always filled with obstacles..."

missions.title: Total Internal Reflection I
missions.description: "The Doll corpses littering the ground hint at some tragic battle that took place here in the past."

missions.title: Sine Curve
missions.description: "Though it's broad daylight, the blue aurora fills the sky."

missions.title: Reversibility I
missions.description: "The snowy skies of Estonia herald the enemy's advance."

missions.title: Cosine Signal
missions.description: "The curtain rises on a terrible battle."

missions.title: Polarizer I
missions.description: "Behind the clearing smoke is our first encounter with Task Force DEFY."

missions.title: Diffraction Grating
missions.description: "I only have two mags left."

missions.title: Waveguide I
missions.description: "With the help of Squad 404, the gate finally opens for the Griffin squads."

missions.title: Beam Splitter
missions.description: "It's time to squeeze the last bit of value out of this train..."

missions.title: Interferometer I
missions.description: "On the other side, the Jeep carrying the AR Team is rushing toward the coastal defense artillery at top speed..."

missions.title: Aperture
missions.description: "M4 and the enemy squad leader engage in a life-or-death pursuit, and the one who finally takes hold of the control lever is..."

missions.title: Vacuum Tube
missions.description: "After successfully infiltrating the base, Squad 404 finds themselves reunited with a long-lost friend..."

missions.title: Accelerator
missions.description: "After being pulled into her neural cloud's base layer, UMP45 relives the most painful day in her memories."

missions.title: Spectrometer I
missions.description: "In order to rescue the AR Team from an enemy pincer attack, Dandelion hacks into the remaining Sangvis forces."

missions.title: Analyzer
missions.description: "Amidst the cold rain, the Sangvis forces, bereft of Elisa, scatter in all directions."

missions.title: Enantiomer Overload I
missions.description: "This is UMP45's first time telling a lie, but nothing could possibly feel more natural."

missions.title: Enantiomer Overload II
missions.description: "In a power room filled with sleeping enemies, UMP45 pulls down the master switch..."

missions.title: Recrystallization Resolution I
missions.description: "Though they have shaken off the enemy's pursuit, Squad 404 is still in danger."

missions.title: Shattered Plane of Polarization I
missions.description: "I am simply a Doll of yours. "

missions.title: Recrystallization Resolution II
missions.description: "The AR Team takes control of the coastal defense artillery, and the second shot is about to be fired..."

missions.title: Shattered Plane of Polarization II
missions.description: "A small squad quickly assembles to help the rest of the main body complete their withdrawal."

missions.title: Asymmetric Induction I
missions.description: "Send him victorious, happy and glorious, long to reign over us, God save the King."

missions.title: Optical Isomer
missions.description: "She stands alone in a kingdom of Dolls, like a jet black reflection in a sea of shadows."

missions.title: Milling I
missions.description: "Perhaps we were both hoping to find the answer we couldn't obtain in each other's neural clouds."

missions.title: Mixing
missions.description: "Squad 404 is coming up with a plan in front of the sealed quarantine door when they are suddenly attacked."

missions.title: Pre-Heating I
missions.description: "UMP45 crawls into the tunnel the enemy left behind them, unwilling to give up. Waiting for her at the other end is..."

missions.title: Sintering
missions.description: "The girl who calls herself Anna joins Squad 404's battle."

missions.title: Foaming
missions.description: "I will do what I must, and so must you!"

missions.title: Foam Stabilization I
missions.description: "Just like then, I won't lose to you."

missions.title: Molding
missions.description: "Give me your strength and let me keep the promise I once made with you."

missions.title: Annealing II
missions.description: "Now is the time to play the ace in the hole."

missions.title: Tempering I
missions.description: "They're buying you the time you want. Don't let them down."

missions.title: Cutting I
missions.description: "In a narrow passage, the remaining Sangvis forces encounter the Military..."

missions.title: Polishing
missions.description: "At the base entrance, the Griffin squads are engaged in a fierce battle with the Military reinforcements."

missions.title: Silvering I
missions.description: "The Commander takes up explosive charges and heads toward the seawater valves."

missions.title: Virtual Image Reforging
missions.description: "A lone mech breaks through the Sangvis perimeter and heads straight for the elevator."

missions.title: Observable Limits I
missions.description: "This isn't the first time we've shot at each other."

missions.title: Light Cone Frame of Reference I
missions.description: "He listens as the seawater draws close, and waits for his final judgement."

missions.title: Causality Separating Plane
missions.description: "The aurora rises above the sky, brighter than it has ever been before."

missions.title: Blackbody Radiation I
missions.description: "Elisa, everything will be over soon."

missions.title: Unknowable Singularity
missions.description: "At risk of being discovered by the enemy, the Commander infiltrates the enemy's back lines...":

missions.title: Escape Acceleration I
missions.description: "What we need is the truth, and not to become puppets."

missions.title: Through the Event Horizon
missions.description: "The seawater is flooding in, and nobody will be able to leave this place."
